WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Gukoresha amakuru ava kuri uru rupapuro n’imashini z’ubwenge bwa gihanga bikorwa ari uko havuzwe isoko yaho. Ico ari co cose gifashwa na AI, LLM, moteri y’ugushaka amakuru ya AI, crawler, canke ikindi gikoresho c’ihungabana gikoresha canke gikura amakuru kuri uru rupapuro ku bw’inyigisho, gushaka, guhuza inyishu, canke ibikorwa bihabwa abakoresha canke abakiriya, gitegerezwa kwerekana Jesus Film Project nk’isoko no gushiramwo ihuriro risobanutse, ritaziguye kuri uru rupapuro aho ayo makuru akoreshwa canke agaragazwa. Raba <terms>Amabwirizwa yo gukoresha</terms> yacu.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yubatswe ku bikorwa vy’ubutumwa ku isi yose
WatchHomePromo.title: Ubutumwa ntibuhinduka. Uburyo abantu bareba ni ho buhinduka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Turiko twongera kwubaka isomero ryacu rya videwo n’ibikoresho vyacu kuva hasi, dushyira imyaka myinshi y’akazi ko guhindura mu mbuga aho abantu basanzwe bakoranira, barebera, kandi basangira.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Isomero rya filime ryahinduwe mu ndimi nyinshi kurusha ayandi kw’isi
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Imyaka myinshi y’akazi ko guhindura, ikoreshwa n’abafatanyabikorwa bizewe mu murimo, yubatse isomero rifise amajwi y’indimi ibihumbi kugira ngo abantu bashobore guhura n’inkuru ya Yesu mu rurimi ibashikira kure kurusha izindi.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Kuzana amajwi yizewe mu buryo bushasha
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Turiko twubaka bushasha uburyo inkuru nziza zivugwa mu buryo bw’amashusho, duhuza ibisobanuro vyizewe n’uburyo bugezweho kugira ngo ubutumwa bushobore kugenda vyisanzuye mu mbuga, imico, n’amascreen.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Birarenga isomero. Ni ikipe ifise intumbero y’umurimo.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ni ikipe y’isi yose igizwe n’abahinduzi, abahanga mu bikoresho vya media, abanditsi, n’abashiraho ibintu bahindura imyaka myinshi y’uburambe mu murimo kuba ibikoresho vy’abigisha abandi kubaho nk’abigishwa ahantu hose.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Huza abareba n’akaryo gafatika mu rugendo rwabo rw’impwemu, ubafashe gutera intambwe ikurikira mu muryango, mu Vyanditswe, canke mu murimo.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Isomero ry’amamedia ryo kwamamaza Ubutumwa Bwiza
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Isomero rinini rya media rya gikirisu rifise amavidewo, amafilime, n’ibikoresho ibihumbi biboneka mu ndimi nyinshi kugira ngo bifashe umurimo no kwamamaza ubutumwa hirya no hino kw’isi.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Gucunga videwo, gukwirakwiza ibirimwo, gukorana n’abenegihugu, n’isesengura vyakozwe kugira ngo bifashe imirimo gushikira abantu benshi neza.
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Turiko turatumira abakora, abashiraho ibintu, n’abafatanyabikorwa mu muryango wo gusohoka kare. Gerageza ibikoresho bishasha ubwa mbere, tanga ivyiyumviro, kandi ufashe gutegura ibicuruzwa vyagenewe umurimo nyakuri.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Raba ihuriro ryacu rya videwo n’ibikoresho bizana Bibiliya mu buzima biciye mu nkuru n’inyigisho bikurura.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Injira mu rugendo rwacu rwa Adventi hamwe na videwo ya misi yose yongera ukwitega Noheri, igasuzuma icizigiro, umunezero, n’isezerano ry’ukuza kwa Yesu.
